product_one_liner.value: Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS that connects business systems through no-code workflow automation and built-in API management for enterprise teams managing integrations.
product_one_liner.notes: The iVoyant product page describes Koodisi as an enterprise integration platform and identifies its integration-management audience.

pricing_page.notes: Koodisi has a public pricing page with an enterprise plan quoted to customer requirements.

named_customers.notes: These names appear in iVoyant capability-statement past-performance highlights.

employee_band.notes: iVoyant’s LinkedIn company profile lists 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company profile sources identify Atlanta, Georgia, United States as iVoyant’s headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn identifies iVoyant as founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The blog has technical posts on LLM routing architecture for an in-house product and building a Firebase/AI CRM; their authors are identified as a machine-learning engineer and a software engineer.

public_docs.notes: Koodisi has a public documentation portal with multiple product and AI workflow articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Greenhouse board lists an AI/ML Engineer opening.

model_provider.notes: The public AI documentation describes configurable model-provider activities and an optional OpenAI connector, but does not identify a default provider used by Koodisi AI.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 but says the certifications have not yet been issued, so neither counts as a current certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes iVoyant as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: Tracxn says iVoyant has not raised any funding, so it did not raise within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Greenhouse board lists openings, but none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 2026 release notes announce Koodisi AI workflow building, deployment, and testing from chat, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page lists four leaders. The two senior executives’ profiles show iVoyant tenures beginning in 2014 and 2018, well before the requested window; no in-window executive change was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An iVoyant SDR job posting names Apollo as a prospecting tool and HubSpot as an example CRM; the posting is marked closed.
